statement:
Observation: The current definition of virtual resolution is so broad and it is not meaningful to parameterize, then.

Is there a well-behaved moduli theory of virtual resolutions equipped with extra structure? e.g. condition under which there exists a finite set? or space/ stacks/...?
(c.f. [Boij-Sölderberg] theory constructs a meaningful cone of Betti tables of all free complexes. Look at subcone of virtual resolutions of a given $M$)
title: Bounded moduli charts and ghost directions for virtual resolutions
